_about: Retrieval golden set. A question is a hit if ANY 'expected' episode appears in the retrieved chunks. Expected episodes were verified by searching the transcripts for each concept and reading the surrounding text (passing mentions excluded). type: named = question uses the framework/guest's own words; paraphrased = describes the idea without its name; applied = Glance-flavoured, the way it would actually be asked.
